fact: Regulations in force 1 June 2026 let the National Cybersecurity Committee designate critical information infrastructure in the financial, public service, ICT, energy and water, and transport sectors, with designations notified in the Gazette.
title: Cybersecurity and Cybercrime (Critical Information Infrastructure Designation) Regulations 2026
publisher: Government of Mauritius, Government Gazette No. 45 (Legal Supplement 601)
